name: spinning-text
title: Spinning Text
description: Letters set around a circle that turns forever, in either direction. Holds still under reduced motion.

props.name: text
props.description: The text that circles. Screen readers read it as one string.

props.name: radius
props.description: Radius of the circle in ch units, so it scales with the font.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Turns the animation off and holds the ring still.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
